excerpt_i18n.en: Shenzhen, July 23 — The Hi3D Entity Creative Ecosystem closed-door meeting was held in Shenzhen. Centered on the theme "Exploring the AI-Driven Next-Generation Manufacturable Ecosystem," Hi3D, along with guests from 3D printing hardware, manufacturing, creators, and the Maker community, discussed the new trend of AI 3D evolving from digital generation to physical manufacturing. This was also the first time since founding Shumei Wanwu that its founder and CEO Ren Lifeng systematically shared Hi3D’s technological progress and industry insights over the past year with media, device partners, and industry collaborators. Jia Rongfei, co-founder and algorithm lead of Shumei Wanwu, also presented milestone algorithmic model optimizations achieved by Hi3D over the past year. On-site, Hi3D unveiled the upcoming next-generation Hi3D 3.0 2048³ model, defining the new SOTA for next-generation general 3D large models. It also systematically elaborated on its "Entity Creative Ecosystem" strategy for the first time: AI 3D is evolving from a pure model generation tool to a connector of creativity, models, devices, materials, and manufacturing, enabling ideas in the digital world to truly enter the physical world. From "expression inclusion" to "creation inclusion" — "We firmly believe that technology should serve human creativity and the desire for expression," said Ren Lifeng. Over the past decade, the internet has continuously lowered the barrier to content expression through text, images, and short videos. Meanwhile, advances in AI and desktop manufacturing have multiplied AI 3D users ninefold in two years, driving the next wave of change from the digital to the physical world. Hi3D aims to propel the shift from "expression inclusion" to "creation inclusion."
excerpt_i18n.es: Shenzhen, 23 de julio — La reunión a puerta cerrada del ecosistema creativo de entidades Hi3D se celebró en Shenzhen. En torno al tema "Explorando el ecosistema fabricable de próxima generación impulsado por IA", Hi3D y los invitados del ámbito del hardware de impresión 3D, fabricación, creadores y makers debatieron sobre las nuevas tendencias de la IA 3D desde la generación digital hasta la fabricación física. Esta fue también la primera vez que Ren Lifeng, fundador y CEO de Shumei Wanwu, representó a Hi3D ante los medios, fabricantes de equipos y socios industriales para compartir sistemáticamente el progreso técnico y las reflexiones industriales de Hi3D durante el año pasado. Jia Rongfei, cofundador y responsable de algoritmos de Shumei Wanwu, también compartió en el acto los hitos alcanzados en la optimización de modelos algorítmicos de Hi3D durante el año pasado.

excerpt_i18n.en: Google Cloud has released a new security blueprint outlining how enterprises should protect AI workloads running on Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE). Google believes that AI applications are moving from prototype to production faster than traditional security models can adapt. Authored by Glen Messenger and Shannon Kularathna, the document proposes a three-layer security framework covering infrastructure security, model integrity, and application security, primarily targeting Chief Information Security Officers (CISOs) and platform engineering teams.
excerpt_i18n.es: Google Cloud ha publicado un nuevo plan de seguridad que detalla cómo las empresas deben proteger las cargas de trabajo de inteligencia artificial ejecutadas en Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE). Google considera que la velocidad con la que las aplicaciones de IA pasan de la fase de prototipo a producción ya supera la capacidad de adaptación de los modelos de seguridad tradicionales. Este documento, redactado por Glen Messenger y Shannon Kularathna, propone un esquema de seguridad en tres capas que abarca la seguridad de la infraestructura, la integridad del modelo y la seguridad de las aplicaciones, dirigido principalmente a los directores de seguridad de la información (CISO) y a los equipos de ingeniería de plataforma.

items.raw_excerpt: 7月23日，即梦AI联合抖音电商、艾菲奖共同发起 “AI 广告爆改大赛”，邀请网友围绕经典广告语、经典广告场景和大众记忆中的品牌内容，使用 AI 技术进行创意改编与视频创作，让经典广告焕发全新生命力。 艾菲奖是国际上具有影响力的实效营销与广告传播奖项体系之一，每年持续认可和表彰最具实效的品牌，营销机构及代理机构。作为本次大赛官方合作发起方，艾菲奖的加入为赛事增添了专业度与行业影响力。 本次大赛由李诞发起，经典广告等您来演 本次大赛获得王老吉、旺旺、玛氏、喜之郎、优乐美、溜溜梅、卡姿兰等多个知名品牌授权，聚焦 “经典回忆” 与 “品牌焕新” 两大方向，设置了品牌赛道与公益赛道等五个创作方向。参赛者可围绕熟悉的广告语、经典场景等进行剧情爆改、脑洞续写、公益表达等多元创作，探索 AI 技术在广告创意中的更多可能。 创作形式上，大赛分为“演绎爆改”和“创意手搓”两个类型。前者主要面向即梦 App 端，创作者可借助分身演绎、一键跟拍等能力生成12秒以内短视频；后者面向即梦 Web 端，鼓励创作者通过剧情反转、视觉特效、完整故事设定等方式，制作12秒以上创意视频。参赛作品需在抖音平台及对应即梦端内发布，并带上大赛主话题及赛道话题。 本次赛事投稿时间将持续至 8月20日，并于8月28日公布最终获奖名单。大赛专业评审团将从用户喜爱、创新能力、技术水平、故事设定、视听表达等维度进行综合评选，最终评选出117条优秀作品。各赛道获奖者将获得现金激励、即梦 AI 积分及艾菲奖荣誉证书等奖励。 即梦 AI 相关负责人表示，广告创作是 AI 视频能力落地的重要场景之一，此次联合抖音电商和艾菲奖发起AI广告爆改大赛，是希望借助品牌经典内容为创作者提供具体实践场景，探索AI 创作在广告创意表达中的实际应用。 雷峰网 雷峰网

excerpt_i18n.en: On July 23, Jimeng AI, in collaboration with Douyin e-commerce and the Effie Awards, launched the "AI Ad Remake Competition," inviting netizens to creatively adapt and produce videos of classic ad slogans, scenes, and brand content using AI technology, giving classic ads a fresh lease on life. The Effie Awards is one of the most influential international awards systems for effective marketing and advertising communications, annually recognizing and honoring the most effective brands, marketing organizations, and agencies. As an official co-organizer of this competition, the involvement of the Effie Awards adds professionalism and industry influence. The competition was initiated by Li Dan, with classic ads awaiting your performance. It has obtained authorization from several well-known brands, including Wanglaoji, Want Want, Mars, Xizhilang, U-Love, Liuliumei, and Carslan, focusing on two major directions: "classic memories" and "brand revitalization," with five creative tracks including brand and public service categories. Participants can create diverse works around familiar ad slogans and classic scenes through plot remakes, imaginative continuations, and public service expressions, exploring more possibilities for AI in advertising creativity. In terms of creative formats, the competition is divided into two types: "performance remake" and "creative handcraft." The former is mainly for the Jimeng App, where creators can generate short videos under 12 seconds using features like avatar performance and one-click follow-shots; the latter is for the Jimeng Web, encouraging creators to produce creative videos over 12 seconds through plot twists, visual effects, and complete story settings. Submissions must be posted on Douyin and the corresponding Jimeng platform.

items.title: Seed STEM科学家计划启动，邀请100位学者探索AI加速科学发现
items.raw_excerpt: 7月23日，Seed Edge团队正式发布Seed STEM 科学家计划。该计划拟邀请100位前沿科学领域学者，与Seed 团队一起，围绕真实科研问题展开合作，识别和突破研究级问题，共同探索 AI 加速科学发现的可能性。 过去几年，大模型在通用问答、代码、数学推理等任务上取得了显著进展，但在真实科研问题中，仍面临更具复杂度的挑战。在此背景下，Seed Edge团队发起了Seed STEM 科学家计划。据了解，该计划主要关注AI在科学领域的研究，参与该计划的学者将与 Seed 团队一起，共同进行更具创造性的科学探索。 该计划对参与学者的研究背景和 AI 使用经验提出了相应期待，希望学者在STEM相关学科领域已获得或正在攻读博士学位，具备深刻的学术积累和透彻的学科理解，对AI加速科学发现有强烈的兴趣和坚定的信念，能清晰判断AI在本领域学科中的应用价值和现有的能力边界。同时，期待参与者在日常科研工作中深度使用AI作为生产力工具。 相关领域学者可根据自身情况，选择以科学家顾问或博士实习生的身份加入项目组。据悉，首期STEM科学家计划约持续6个月，在此期间，参与学者需来到Seed办公区，与团队一起开展工作。 该计划将为参与学者提供充足的算力资源和专业的AI研究团队支持。同时，为充分认可参与学者的科研价值和贡献，Seed团队将为其提供业界极具竞争力的薪酬回报。 面对AI时代的巨大机遇，字节跳动 Seed 团队并未止步于模型迭代，而是选择进入技术深水区，探索下一代AI。去年，字节跳动发起了Seed Edge 研究计划，专注于探索未知的智能边界和长期重要课题，并确定了五大研究方向。近期，Edge 团队公开的EdgeBench在业内受到广泛关注，这是首个用于衡量真实世界环境学习的超长程评测集，并发现了环境学习中的Scaling Law。据了解，本次Seed STEM 科学家计划也是由定位长期

excerpt_i18n.en: On July 23, the Seed Edge team officially launched the Seed STEM Scientist Program. The program plans to invite 100 scholars in cutting-edge scientific fields to collaborate with the Seed team on real scientific research problems, identify and overcome research-level challenges, and jointly explore the potential of AI-accelerated scientific discovery. In recent years, large models have made significant progress in tasks such as general question-answering, coding, and mathematical reasoning, but still face more complex challenges in real scientific research problems. Against this backdrop, the Seed Edge team launched the Seed STEM Scientist Program. It is understood that the program primarily focuses on AI research in science, and scholars participating in the program will work with the Seed team to conduct more creative scientific exploration. The program sets expectations for participants' research background and AI experience. It expects scholars to have obtained or be pursuing a doctoral degree in STEM-related disciplines, possess deep academic accumulation and thorough understanding of the discipline, have strong interest and firm belief in AI
excerpt_i18n.es: El 23 de julio, el equipo Seed Edge lanzó oficialmente el Plan Seed STEM Científicos. El plan invitará a 100 académicos de campos científicos punteros a colaborar con el equipo Seed en problemas reales de investigación, identificar y superar desafíos de nivel investigador, y explorar conjuntamente la posibilidad de que la IA acelere los descubrimientos científicos. En los últimos años, los grandes modelos han logrado avances significativos en tareas como preguntas y respuestas generales, código y razonamiento matemático, pero aún enfrentan desafíos más complejos en problemas de investigación reales. En este contexto, el equipo Seed Edge lanzó el Plan Seed STEM Científicos. Según se informa, el plan se centra principalmente en la IA en el ámbito científico.

items.title: 腾讯混元组织架构再升级，合并大语言模型和多模态团队，加速模型研发
items.raw_excerpt: 7 月 23 日，腾讯宣布混元多模态模型部门与大语言模型部门合并，成立基础模型部，统一由腾讯首席 AI 科学家姚顺雨管理，以进一步提升模型研发和协同效率，探索全模态模型的智能上限。 以大语言模型为基础，腾讯混元构建了图像、视频、语音、3D 生成模型等完整的模型矩阵。2026 年以来，腾讯混元模型迭代速度不断加快，与腾讯公司业务的协同也持续增强。 7 月正式上线的大语言模型 Hy3，展现出显著强于同尺寸模型且比肩参数规模 2-5 倍的旗舰模型的智能水平，已在 WorkBuddy/CodeBuddy、元宝、Marvis、ima 等多个业务接入，API 已在腾讯云 TokenHub 以及多个海外平台上线。发布一周后， Hy3 总调用量较上一代模型（Hy2）增长超 68 倍，WorkBuddy 自选模型的用户中，选择 Hy3 的占比达到 60%。 混元多模态模型也在持续进化。4 月发布并开源的混元 3D 世界模型 2.0（Hy World 2.0）能够根据文字、图片、视频等不同类型输入，自动生成、重建和模拟 3D 世界，同时支持多格式 3D 资产导出，能与现有的游戏工作流无缝对接，快速生成游戏地图和关卡原型。混元 3D 系列模型的社区下载量超过 300 万，是全球最受欢迎的 3D 开源模型。混元图像模型3.0 在 LMArena 榜单上居国内开源模型第一。 雷峰网 雷峰网

excerpt_i18n.en: On July 23, Tencent announced the merger of its Hunyuan multimodal model department and large language model department, establishing a foundational model unit under the unified management of Tencent's Chief AI Scientist, Yao Shunyu, to further improve model development and collaboration efficiency and explore the upper limits of full-modal model intelligence. Based on large language models, Tencent Hunyuan has built a complete model matrix encompassing image, video, voice, and 3D generation models. Since 2026, the iteration pace of Tencent's Hunyuan model has accelerated, with increasing synergy with Tencent's business operations. The large language model Hy3, officially launched in July, demonstrates significantly stronger intelligence than models of the same size and rivals flagship models with two to five times the parameter scale. It has been integrated into multiple business applications such as WorkBuddy/CodeBuddy, Yuanbao, Marvis, and ima, with its API available on Tencent Cloud TokenHub and several overseas platforms. One week after launch, total invocations of Hy3 grew over 68 times compared to the previous generation model (Hy2), and among WorkBuddy users who opted for custom models, the proportion choosing Hy3 reached 60%. The Hunyuan multimodal model is also continuously evolving. The Hunyuan 3D World Model 2.0 (Hy World 2.0), released and open-sourced in April, can automatically generate, reconstruct, and simulate 3D worlds based on different input types such as text, images, and videos.
excerpt_i18n.es: El 23 de julio, Tencent anunció la fusión del departamento de modelos multimodales Hunyuan con el departamento de modelos de lenguaje grande, creando el Departamento de Modelos Fundamentales, que será gestionado unificadamente por el científico jefe de IA de Tencent, Yao Shunyu, con el fin de mejorar la eficiencia en la investigación y desarrollo de modelos y en la colaboración, así como explorar el límite de inteligencia de los modelos multimodales completos. Basándose en modelos de lenguaje grande, Hunyuan de Tencent ha construido una matriz completa de modelos que incluye modelos de generación de imágenes, video, voz y 3D. Desde 2026, la velocidad de iteración del modelo Hunyuan de Tencent se ha acelerado continuamente, y la sinergia con los negocios de Tencent también ha seguido aumentando. El modelo de lenguaje grande Hy3, lanzado oficialmente en julio, muestra un rendimiento significativamente superior a modelos del mismo tamaño y comparable al de los modelos insignia con 2 a 5 veces su número de parámetros.

excerpt_i18n.en: On July 22, 2026, Acemate officially signed a partnership agreement with the 2026 China Open. Under this collaboration, Acemate will serve as the exclusive designated tennis training robot supplier for the 2026 China Open, entering the tournament’s ecosystem. The significance of this partnership extends beyond a standard event sponsorship announcement. For Acemate, it marks a critical milestone as its AI tennis training robot moves from daily training, club experiences, and shared courts into the professional tournament system. This indicates that the new category of AI tennis training robots is entering a more realistic, higher-standard tennis environment with greater public visibility. The China Open is one of Asia’s highest-level comprehensive international tennis tournaments for both men and women. As a key platform connecting Chinese tennis with the global tennis community, the China Open not only hosts top-tier competition but also continuously expands the integration of event experience, fan interaction, and sports technology. Acemate’s entry into the China Open partnership stems from a shared focus on “upgrading tennis training experience.” Unlike traditional ball-serving machines, the Acemate AI tennis training robot features mobility, ball retrieval, serving, human-robot rallying, and training data recording and analysis. Through AI visual perception and robotic motion control, Acemate aims to transform solo tennis training from one-way ball feeding into a practice closer to real-match movement, judgment, and continuous rallies.

items.title: Building trade assistant: How Jefferies optimized front office trading operations with AI
items.raw_excerpt: In this post, we explore how Jefferies overcame these challenges with a solution built on Strands Agents, an agent harness SDK for building AI agents that can reason, plan, and act by orchestrating calls to foundation models (FMs) and external tools. The solution uses large language models (LLMs), Amazon Bedrock, and Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Bases. It also uses Model Context Protocol (MCP), an open standard that helps AI agents securely connect to diverse data sources and tools through a unified interface. We cover the solution overview, the rationale for selecting the underlying technology stack, lessons learned, and the business impact the solution created at Jefferies.
